_source: Field trial reports written by students on the Advanced Programs. The reports exist and circulate internally; none has been cleared for publication yet. The three entries below are placeholders that carry the shape of a real one, so the structure can be reviewed before any data arrives. Nothing in them is a finding.
_schema: slug, practitioner, location, country, climate, site_type, crop, method, duration, measurements[], result, conclusion, images[], status. 'note' and 'owner' are added by this repository for placeholder tracking and never print as body text; tools/fieldtrials.py turns them into .todo blocks that ?notes=1 reveals. A measurement is {"what": "", "before": "", "after": "", "method": ""}.

trials.note: An orchard transition report. Needed: the report itself, the practitioner's written permission to publish it under their name, and the raw measurements behind every figure quoted.
trials.owner: Evan, with the Advanced Programs teaching team
